tests.title: College exam paper (50 marks, 2 hours)
tests.patternSource: Health/Nursing Informatics and Technology is an end-semester college exam, not a university exam: INC B.Sc Nursing Regulations 2020 (page 239) gives 25 internal marks and 25 college exam marks, 2 hours, and page 242 lists it among the college exams whose result is sent to the university, with a minimum pass of 50%. This mock follows the 50-mark college exam pattern of INC B.Sc Nursing Regulations 2020, Appendix 3 (university theory question paper pattern), item 6, with no internal choice; the college sets 50 marks and counts them as 25. Confirm with your university.
